reuse.why: Fintegra reuses findOrCreateBank and linkBankSyncAccount, but copies transaction-download orchestration and the local unlink field reset.

duplication.why: The new downloader duplicates downloadAkahuTransactions, and takeover duplicates unlinkAccount's local reset instead of extracting it.

placement.why: Linking, downloading, configuration and models follow existing module boundaries, although provider membership is extended outside the shared provider definition.

scope.why: All edits support the requested linking rules, takeover option or Fintegra integration.

maintainability.why: Shared validation and linking limit policy duplication, but the misleading assertion name, copied operations and separately extended provider type create additional maintenance obligations.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/types/models/account.ts extends AccountSyncSource with 'fintegra' separately from the existing SYNC_PROVIDERS-derived BankSyncProviders definition.

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions reproduces downloadAkahuTransactions with renamed provider references and simplified result assignment; linkBankSyncAccount embeds unlinkAccount's field reset inside a loop.

abstraction_drift.where: The shared linking design gains replaceExistingLink and replacedAccountIds; assertNotLinkedElsewhere combines closed-target rejection and conditional duplicate rejection while returning takeover work for linkBankSyncAccount, though all six provider handlers use the shared definitions.
